subjective.unit: Chief Complaint: Right elbow pain since yesterday
subjective.citation_text: Doctor: Hello. Could you tell me your age and gender, and what brings you in today? Patient: Hello. I'm 48 years old, and I'm a female. I'm here because my right elbow has been hurting a lot since yesterday. I felt a pop when I was lifting a box while moving, and it's been throbbing ever since. Doctor: Could you please describe the nature of the pain in your right elbow? Is it sharp, dull, or throbbing? Have you noticed any swelling or bruising? Patient: The pain is throbbing, and it gets worse when I take the ice off. There's some swelling and redness around the elbow, but no bruising that I can see. It hurts when I try to bend or straighten my arm. Doctor: Have you experienced any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your right arm or hand since the injury? Patient: No, I haven't felt any numbness, tingling, or weakness in my arm or hand. My fingers move fine, and I don't have any pain there. The issue is really just around my elbow. Doctor: Have you experienced any prior elbow injuries, surgeries, or conditions such as arthritis or tendinitis? Patient: No, I don't have any prior elbow injuries or surgeries. The only surgery I've had was on my neck, and I don't have any history of arthritis or tendinitis in my elbow. This is the first time I've had this kind of pain. Doctor: Could you describe the exact location of the popping sensation and whether there was any immediate deformity or inability to move the elbow at the time of injury? Patient: The popping sensation happened right here at my elbow, on the outside, when I lifted the box up. There wasn't any deformity or inability to move it right away, but it started hurting pretty badly after that. Doctor: Have you experienced any instability, locking, or crepitus in the elbow joint since the injury? Patient: No, I haven't felt any instability, locking, or cre
